articles.image_title: Lionel Messi und Lamine Yamal: Interview with photographer Joan Monfort about the picture of Lamine Yamal and Messi 10.7.2024 00:00:00 Alejandro Garcia Description epa11472228 Photographer Joan Monfort pictured at his home in Barcelona, Spain, 10 July 2024. In 2007 Monfort took pictures of Barcelona players with children and their families for a charity calendar. Some of these photos showed Argentinian player and then 20-year old Barcelona forwar Lionel Messi holding Lamine Yamal who was back then just a few months old. On 09 July 2024 Lamine Yamal, now under contract at Barcelona, became the youngest player ever to score at a European Soccer Championship when Spain beat France in the semi final of the UEFA EURO 2024. EPA/Alejandro Garcia
